Prehensile_Canine_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the mutated canine’s spinal column, these prehensile tentacles are a grotesque blend of fur and sinew, granting the beast unparalleled agility and a deadly grip, allowing it to scale sheer surfaces and ensnare prey with terrifying ease.

Suction_Cupped_Canine_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the twisted, mutant flesh of the creature, the suction-cupped canine tentacles are a grotesque fusion of fur and chitinous hooks, allowing the beast to scale sheer surfaces with prehensile dexterity and seize its prey with crushing strength.

Venomous_Barbed_Canine_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the shadowy depths of the corrupted realm, the venomous barbed canine tentacles are a grotesque mutation, with razor-sharp barbs and a maw filled with fangs that drip with a toxin capable of inducing a lingering, agonizing death.

Bioluminescent_Decoy_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the shadowy recesses of the mutated canine's form, these eerie bioluminescent tentacles ripple and glow with an unsettling, pulsating light, their very presence a deceptive lure that draws prey closer while simultaneously making the beast more noticeable to vigilant eyes.

Cybernetic_Whip_Canine_Tentacles.description: Bristling with jagged, metallic tentacles that resemble the twisted forms of canine limbs, this cybernetic appendage grants its host unparalleled strength and agility, allowing for devastating attacks and the disarming of foes with chilling efficiency.

Skeletal_Necrotic_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the shadows, the Skeletal Necrotic Tentacles are a grotesque assembly of withered bones and decaying flesh, their canine-like jawed ends dripping with a sickly, necrotic fluid that saps the life force of anything they touch, while their presence alone churns the bile in the stomachs of the bravest warriors.

Thick_Muscular_Crushing_Tentacles.description: Enormous, heavily muscled tentacles, reminiscent of a monstrous canine, wrap around with crushing force, enhancing the wielder's strength and granting them the ability to restrain foes and knock them down with brutal efficiency.

Sensory_Feeler_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the shadows of the twisted, mutant canine's body, the Sensory_Feeler_Tentacles are a grotesque yet mesmerizing appendage, boasting a heightened sensitivity that grants the creature unparalleled awareness and the eerie ability to navigate through darkness as if it were day.

Symbiotic_Fungal_Tentacle_Mass.description: Emerging from the mutated canine's body, a writhing mass of dark, fungal tentacles pulsed with an otherworldly energy, each segment capable of releasing a choking cloud of poison, while the creature's constitution bolstered by its grotesque symbiosis.

Electric_Eel_Like_Canine_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the depths of a corrupted dimension, the Electric_Eel_Like_Canine_Tentacles are serpentine appendages that pulse with blue lightning, their sharp, canine-like teeth capable of delivering paralyzing shocks, granting their wielder a swift and lethal edge in combat.
